title: Evidence Entitlement Audit — Semantic Adapter Reference Implementation
description: Public-safe reference implementation and reproducibility artifacts for the supervised semantic-adapter Exp1 surrounding the human-governed Evidence Entitlement Audit kernel. Includes frozen prompt/governance artifacts, repeatability-analysis utilities, synthetic regression tests, and explicit EEA-kernel/AIT software-lineage boundaries. Does not redefine canonical EEA entitlement semantics and does not automate final scientific adjudication.
notes: EEA kernel semantics are inherited unchanged; final entitlement remains human-governed.
